title: gen-types --check already FAILED at HEAD dd306cc: packages/core/src/index.ts was out of sync with the generator
evidence: Before any schema edit, `node scripts/gen-types.mjs --check` (this lane's changes stashed) printed `DRIFT: packages\core\src\index.ts does not match schema/`. The committed index.ts lacked 8 domain re-exports (keyframe-dedupe-validate, lean-video, pipeline-workflow, pipeline-workflow-reduce, slide-turn-alignment, speaker-tile-alignment, speaker-tile-names, speaker-tile-scan) and carried 3 hand-added run-state-store re-exports the generator does not emit. This lane ran the generator, so index.ts now matches (run-state-store re-exports dropped; grep finds no importer of them through @lkb/core). The CI sync gate would have failed on master independent of this unit.

title: Runtime evidence interfaces in grounded.ts duplicate the new canonical CitedItem/QaEntry/QuotedEvidence; QA answer/status coupling is validated but not typed
evidence: packages/index/src/pipeline/grounded.ts declares RuntimeEvidence, RuntimeItem and RuntimeQA with the same shapes as the generated QuotedEvidence, CitedItem and QaEntry (packages/core/src/generated/session_pages.ts). The plan (webinar-release-repair-plan.md) says no duplicate canonical item interfaces; replacing them is deliberately left to the T-040 generation unit. Also json-schema-to-typescript ignores the QaEntry if/then/else, so TypeScript allows answer:string with status:unanswered; only JSON-schema validation (schema/validate.py fixtures) enforces it.
